text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO alert: APAC ingress 5xx rate > 15% for 2m (envoy). Auto-paging on-call rotation.

lucas (on-call): Oncall here — joining. initial glance: POSTs failing, spike across apac1 AZs. attaching quick graphs.

meera (eng-sre): seeing cluster-wide `upstream_connection_failure` and `reset` spikes from Envoy. NLB target health bouncing in apac1c. Started ~3m ago.

han (network): cloud console shows inter-AZ packet drop events in apac1 — provider alarmed us to increased NIC errors in two hosts. Opening case CLOUD-90123.

zoe (runtime): KV-layer reports sharp increase in cold miss followed by retries, probably exacerbating load. Many clients are retrying, amplifying the effect.

omar (support): customers reporting timeouts; high-touch customer A marked as P1. Drafting blurb: "We are investigating increased errors in APAC; mitigation in progress." Hold for ops ok.

lucas (on-call): immediate ops: 1) stop any ingress rollout/canaries 2) freeze autoscaler spikes 3) reduce Route53 weight for apac1 records for production endpoints to 0% 4) relax NLB health checks to limit churn 5) temp increase envoy upstream timeouts. meera/han/zoe own.

deploy-bot: Aborting ingress canary pipeline #904 as requested by lucas.

meera (eng-sre): Pausing HPA and locking replicas to current count: `kubectl patch hpa ingress -n ingress --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6, "maxReplicas":6}}'`. Also set `deployment.kubernetes.io/revision` freeze.

han (network): Initiating Route53 weight shift: apac1 -> 0, apac2 60, eu1 40. Creating change batch; TTL currently 45s. Submitting: `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --change-batch file://drain-apac1.json`.

zoe (runtime): Pushing an Envoy config override to increase `upstream_idle_timeout` 30s->120s and enable `tcp_keepalive` probes. Rolling to 30% of pods first: `kubectl apply -f envoy-temporary.json -n ingress`.

meera (eng-sre): Adjusting NLB target group healthcheck interval to 30s and deregistration delay to 300s for apac1 to avoid thrashing while cloud investigates. Done.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-APAC-INGRESS-221999 created, severity high.

han (network): Provider replied: "we're seeing elevated NIC error counters; rebooting a subset of hosts and rolling NIC driver updates. ETA unknown." Added case note.

omar (support): Sending short customer update now. "We've detected a regional network degradation affecting APAC endpoints. Traffic is being routed to alternate regions; mitigations underway." Posting to affected customers list.

lucas (on-call): good. two quick follow-ups: (A) lower TTL to 10s for 10 minutes to reduce DNS cached hits? (B) consider emergency short lived sticky session disable to avoid cross-AZ retries? thoughts?

meera (eng-sre): A) go ahead with TTL=10s for 10m window — we need failover faster. B) disabling sticky sessions risks session affinity breaks for some customers; prefer to keep but disable for noisy endpoints only (POST heavy). I'll patch target group settings for the critical path.

han (network): TTL set to 10s. Route53 change pushed. Note: some ISP caches may ignore. Also disabling stickiness for path `/v1/generate` on load balancer to avoid affinity causing retries to bad AZ.

zoe (runtime): After these changes, 5xx dropped from 22% -> ~9% in apac1 within 7 minutes. KV thrash reduced. Still higher than baseline.

omar (support): Received a ticket from enterprise C complaining about intermittent failures despite mitigation. Asked for `dig` results; they report TTL still 60 at their resolver. Looks like upstream carrier cache. We should escalate guidance to ask customers to flush DNS or use regional endpoint as workaround.

lucas (on-call): ok. send a targeted message to those customers with the regional endpoint workaround. Also log that cache persistence is expected.

omar (support): Sent targeted workaround to enterprise C. collecting logs/req ids.

meera (eng-sre): Proposing a controlled reweight strategy once provider confirms NIC fix: 10% increments every 2 minutes, watch Envoy resets and NLB UnhealthyHostCount. han — coordinate with provider.

han (network): Provider says hosts are coming back up; running telemetry. I'll coordinate slow reintroduce and request post-reboot NIC diagnostics.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] Route53 drained; Envoy timeouts increased; NLB healthchecks relaxed. Provider investigating NICs. Next update in 10 minutes.

zoe (runtime): With TTL drop + drain, apac1 traffic is now ~4%. APAC 5xx overall down to ~1.8%. Monitoring for cached hits.

omar (support): Support surge peaked; urgent queue handled. Sending a status update to all affected customers: "Errors reduced; majority of traffic routed away. Next update in 30 minutes."

lucas (on-call): Handoff: I'm scheduled to go offline in 35 minutes. meera will take primary; han remains on-network. meera, please ack PD and take over.

meera (eng-sre): Acknowledged PD-APAC-INGRESS-221999. Taking primary. I'll coordinate reintroduce when han gives go-ahead. zoe keep runtime watch for resets.

han (network): Provider now reports NIC error counters returned to baseline on patched hosts. They are running stabilization checks. I'll begin +10% ramp in 2m if no regressions.

zoe (runtime): OK watching metrics. If we see `upstream_reset` > baseline + sigma, we abort ramp.

incident-bot: [PROGRESS] provider telemetry shows stabilization; initiating gradual reintroduction plan.

han (network): Applied +10% weight to apac1 (now 10%). Observation window 2m.

meera (eng-sre): No spikes observed. Proceed with next +10%.

zoe (runtime): no regressions. connection_reset stable. 5xx remains at baseline ~0.4%.

omar (support): Customer follow-ups: enterprise C confirmed their traffic is now succeeding after switching to regional endpoint; they will revert to global endpoint when TTL updates.

lucas (on-call): thanks team. I'm handing off primary to meera now — staying reachable for 30m. meera, please confirm you have PD acknowledged.

meera (eng-sre): Confirm PD acknowledged and taking primary. Will file post-incident notes once provider RCA available.

incident-bot: [RESOLVED] Provider reports full fabric remediation; incident downgraded to monitoring. Please keep timeline up to date with any follow-ups.

meera (eng-sre): final status: mitigations executed -> pause canaries, HPA freeze, Route53 drain + TTL decrease, NLB healthcheck/deregistration tune, Envoy timeout/pool tweaks, temporary stickiness disable for heavy POST path, targeted customer workarounds. Provider fixed NIC drivers and rebooted hosts; RCA pending. Action items: 1) add DNS emergency TTL playbook 2) add runbook step to disable stickiness for noisy POST endpoints during AZ flaps 3) revisit autoscaler sensitivity to transient target churn.

omar (support): closing customer comms loop; support tickets resolved or escalated to account teams.

zoe (runtime): runtime watch ended after 30m stable. reverting non-essential envoy overrides per meera's note.

incident-bot: Incident timeline pinned. Please add any remediation notes to the incident tracker.

meera (eng-sre): Thanks all — good quick coordination. I'll draft a short postmortem once provider RCA is shared. Closing my primary shift. :white_check_mark:
